title: AttemptAbort

AttemptAbort.description: reeval to the runner: the attempt was aborted, as `c.signal` aborts. Calls in flight reply with errors; the runner should stop the body and send `done`.

message.description: reeval's sentence, e.g. `Eval timed out after 600s`.

reason.description: `timeout`: the eval's `timeout` ran out. `canceled`: the run was stopped.
